Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the issuance of commercial drivers' licenses to certain veterans with truck driving experience.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing a more direct path to a commercialdriver's license for military veterans and veterans of the nationalguard who have truck driving experience; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature recognizes that veterans arean important part of our community and that current policies andprograms fail to consider their relevant experience in drivingcommercial vehicles while serving our country. Further, thelegislature recognizes that commercial vehicles are an integral part ofour state's economy and that many employers are facing a shortage ofqualified employees. Therefore, it is the intent of the legislature toestablish an accelerated pathway for military veterans, and veterans ofthe national guard, who have relevant truck driving experience toreceive a commercial driver's license. As it stands, military veterans are eligible to take an eightweekcourse while working toward receiving a commercial driver's license.It is the intent of the legislature to create an alternative pilotprogram for veterans that will allow them to take a shorter course p. 1 HB 2453instead, and to accomplish this goal, will establish a partnershipbetween an institute of higher learning, the Washington statedepartment of veteran affairs, and local trucking companies.
